title: A workspace project the company runs (<workspace>/<project>/<pack project_file>)
description: The team hired for this project from the company catalog, its goal and budget. State lives next to it in <pack state_dir>/ (never committed).

goal.description: What this project is for; every task contract carries it (mission > project goal > task).

roster.description: Agents hired from the company catalog for this project (default: every enabled agent). The orchestrator is always on it. Changed by the human (<human prefix>staff).

daily_budget_usd.description: Overrides spending.max_cost_usd_per_day for this project; the human is notified at 80%.

default_ai.description: Lowest-precedence AI selection for this project.
